Who I am

An Information Technology graduate from Sri Manakula Vinayagar Engineering College, Pondicherry, building a career in AWS cloud and DevOps engineering.

  • B.Tech Information Technology, 2022–2026
  • Web Development Intern, NSIC Chennai

02

What I do

I design, deploy and automate AWS applications, from networking and containers to CI/CD pipelines and monitoring.

  • Scalable architectures on VPC, ECS/Fargate and RDS
  • CI/CD with CodePipeline, CodeBuild and GitHub
  • Serverless workflows with S3, Lambda and DynamoDB
03

How I think

Secure the network first, automate every deployment, and watch everything with logs and metrics.

  • Secure: subnets, security groups and IAM roles
  • Automate: pipelines and containers
  • Observe: CloudWatch and CloudTrail

01AWS · Architecture

Enterprise E-Commerce & Order Management Platform on AWS

  • Designed and deployed a scalable, highly available architecture using VPC, ECS/Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL and an Application Load Balancer, with secure networking through subnets, security groups and IAM.
  • Implemented CI/CD with AWS CodePipeline and CodeBuild, integrating GitHub for version control and automating build and deployment workflows.
  • Integrated S3 and SQS for storage and asynchronous communication, with CloudWatch and CloudTrail for monitoring, logging and AWS activity tracking.

02AWS · CI/CD

Automated Web Application Deployment Using AWS CI/CD

  • Designed and deployed a scalable web application environment using EC2, VPC and an Application Load Balancer, with secure networking through subnets and security groups.
  • Implemented secure IAM roles and Amazon S3 for AWS resource access and build artifact management, with CloudWatch for application and infrastructure monitoring.

03AWS · Serverless

Serverless Image Processing Pipeline on AWS

  • Developed a serverless image-processing workflow using Amazon S3 and AWS Lambda to automatically generate image thumbnails upon upload.
  • Integrated DynamoDB to store image metadata and CloudWatch to monitor execution logs and processing errors.
